_comment: Trapline supply contacts. These are who you buy BULK from; bulk cannot be sold until it
has been cut and bagged (wheel > Cut).
Contacts have no fixed map position on purpose. Calling one arranges a meet at a spot
chosen near you at runtime and puts a blip on it, so nothing here depends on hardcoded
coordinates that could drop a ped through the map.
kind             Docks | Mob | Gang | Street (flavour, and it gates nothing on its own)
models           ped models tried IN ORDER. The first one actually present in your install
is used, so a wrong or DLC-only name costs flavour, not the feature.
priceMultiplier  applied to the wholesale price. Below 1.0 is a better deal.
minRank          player rank index 0-4 (Pee-Wee, Soldier, Enforcer, Shotcaller, OG)
maxOrderGrams    largest single order this contact will move
openHour/closeHour  operating hours, 0-24. Wraps midnight when open > close.

suppliers.name: Out-of-town Crew
suppliers.blurb: Mid price. They ask who you run with.
